name: Elder Abuse
overview: Scripture calls believers to demonstrate the fruit of the Spirit—love, gentleness, and longsuffering—in all relationships, including with elders. Honoring and obeying those in authority, such as parents and spiritual leaders, is pleasing to the Lord and reflects a heart submitted to His will. Neglecting the needs of the vulnerable, as illustrated by the failure to provide food and drink, is a serious offense that grieves both God and those who watch over souls. Willful sin in this regard bears spiritual consequences, emphasizing the importance of caring for and respecting our elders as part of faithful Christian living.
